title: Library hours
text: The campus research library is open from 8 AM to 10 PM Monday through Friday and from 10 AM to 6 PM on weekends.

title: Interlibrary loan
text: Interlibrary loan requests can be submitted online. Articles usually arrive within two business days, while books may take one to two weeks.

title: Study rooms
text: Graduate students can reserve study rooms for up to three hours per day using the library booking portal.

title: Citation help
text: The library offers citation help for APA, MLA, and Chicago styles through weekday drop-in consultations.
